findings.title: Multiplicity exp3 planned comparisons (Experiment 3, planned comparisons)
findings.description: Recorded partly to document that multiplicity is NOT a problem in this paper, which is worth saying explicitly. findings.description: The headline count of 20 errors in 22 statistics badly overstates the problem and must not be reported as-is. statcheck compares a reported p against the recomputed one without carrying the printed precision, so it flags .008 against .007877 and .03 against .025341 as errors when both are ordinary rounding. findings.title: Exp3 design sensitivity (Experiment 3, Participants)
findings.description: No experiment in this paper reports an a-priori power analysis, so verify_power_analysis has nothing to check, and that absence is itself the reporting observation. required_n renders no verdict and its severity is always `consistent`; a small study is not a wrong one. The comparison worth making is against e3_effect_sizes_extreme: a design with 12 per cell, powered to detect roughly d = 0.8 only at twice its size, returns observed effects near g = 5. That is the combination in which selection inflates estimates, and it is for the editorial pass to weigh.
